searchText: Regarding changes related to gasPrice in RPC methods : - Legacy transaction pre london (gasPrice) - 1559 transaction post london (effectivePriorityFeePerGas) And the question is for Legacy transaction post london should we return the gasPrice or the effectivePriorityFeePerGas (gasPrice-baseFee)? The receipt should have `effectiveGasPrice` I think? `effectivePriorityFeePerGas` can be calculated from that and the block header. In a perfect world, the transaction should only contain transaction data. It should be the receipt that contains the all of the data that is only available *after* a block has been mined. Unfortunately, for legacy reasons there are a number of fields returned with the receipt that are unavailable until after mining (like block number, block hash, etc.). I don't think we should go and break those, but I don't think we should be adding *more* stuff to that set. The question if I remember correctly was to put gasPrice for 1559 transactions returned when calling eth_getTransactionByHash for example. And if I remember well it had been said to put effectivePriorityFeePerGas in the gasPrice field in this case for mined transaction and maxfeePerGas for unmined. But maybe I misunderstood . I'm not talking about the recepit . That's correct. Ok thank you and for the transaction legacy pre / post london gasPrice will always be gasPrice Yep 👍 ok thanks

Regarding changes related to gasPrice in RPC methods :
- Legacy transaction pre london (gasPrice)
- 1559 transaction post london (effectivePriorityFeePerGas)
And the question is for Legacy transaction post london should we return the gasPrice or the effectivePriorityFeePerGas (gasPrice-baseFee)?
